comparison.objective: Open a threaded flashlight, remove its battery, and sort the parts; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterholding plus repeated cap twist/regrasp, axial thread following, tipping, and placement. It lacks key insertion, retained adjustment, locking torque, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Cap and battery removed and deposited safely, flashlight replaced; body supplies numeric stages but no separate spec version.
comparison.reason: Some rotational regrasp overlap is generic; threaded disassembly and battery extraction do not test damper adjustment or dynamic validation.
